faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to frequently asked questions about our services.

items.question: Is a photographer included in the price?
items.answer: Yes, all packages include a professional photographer from Morain. You do not need to bring your own.

items.question: Can I bring my own photographer?
items.answer: No, because every session already includes our internal photographer to ensure consistent photo quality.

items.question: Can I bring my own props?
items.answer: Yes, as long as they are safe and do not damage studio facilities. Please coordinate with us beforehand if bringing large props.

items.question: What is the maximum capacity per room?
items.answer: Studio Small: max 5 people, Studio Medium: max 15 people, Studio Large: max 30 people. For Photobox max 5 people.

items.question: Can I reschedule my booking?
items.answer: Yes, rescheduling can be requested up to 24 hours prior depending on schedule availability. Please contact us via WhatsApp.

items.question: What is the refund policy?
items.answer: Cancellations receive a partial refund according to terms & conditions. Cancellation at least 24 hours prior receives a 50% refund of the down payment.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: We accept payments via BCA, BNI, QRIS, Dana, and GoPay. A minimum 50% down payment is required to secure your slot.

items.question: Can photobox photos be printed?
items.answer: Yes! Photo strip and 4R prints are available. You also receive all digital soft copies and QR download access.

items.question: How long is each photobox session?
items.answer: Each photobox session lasts 15 minutes, including preparation and photo taking.

items.question: Are there any extra fees besides the listed price?
items.answer: No hidden fees. The listed price is all-inclusive, covering the photographer, lighting equipment, and studio facilities.

bookingProcess.q: How do I book a studio or photobox?
bookingProcess.a: Choose the package you want, select the available date and time, then make the payment. You will receive a booking confirmation via email and WhatsApp.

payment.a: We accept payments via bank transfer, e-wallets (OVO, GoPay, Dana), and credit/debit cards via Midtrans payment gateway.

cancellation.q: Can I reschedule or cancel my booking?
cancellation.a: Rescheduling can be done at least 24 hours before the scheduled booking. For cancellations, please contact us via WhatsApp.

photographer.q: Is a photographer included in the studio package?
photographer.a: Yes, all studio packages include a professional photographer ready to assist your photo session.

duration.q: How long is the photo session?
duration.a: Studio session duration depends on the package you choose (per hour). For photobox, the standard duration is 10 minutes per session.

props.q: Can I bring my own props?
props.a: Of course! You are free to bring your own photo props to complete your photo session.
